verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a public REST Developer API at developers.fellow.ai. It uses API-key authentication and cursor-based pagination, and it covers both reads (notes, recordings with transcripts, action items, the authenticated user) and writes (append, prepend, find-replace or overwrite note agendas, complete or archive action items, upload recordings and track their status). A machine-readable llms.txt is also published. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and evidence of endpoints for creating new notes or action items.
